title: Notice for parents and guardians

sections.heading: What this is
sections.text: {username} would like an Oreheart account. Oreheart is a card battle game. An account lets {username} save decks and, later, play with other players online. Because {username} is under 13, we need your yes before the account can be used online.

sections.heading: What we keep
sections.text: We keep the username, your email address (the parent or guardian's), the decks and game progress of the account, and a record of your approval. That is all.

sections.heading: What we do not collect
sections.text: We do not ask for a birth date, a photo, a real name, a phone number or a home address. There is no chat and no free text between players.

sections.heading: Who sees what
sections.text: Nothing about the account is shared with other people or companies. Other players can only see the username during a game.

sections.heading: Withdrawing approval
sections.text: You can withdraw your approval at any time with the link in the confirmation email we send you after you approve. The account then stops working online.

sections.heading: Deleting the account
sections.text: To have the account and its data deleted, use the Contact us form: {contact_url}

sections.heading: Questions
sections.text: Please use the Contact us form at {contact_url}. We answer from a no-reply address, so please leave a reply email in the form if you would like an answer.

lawyer_review: Check the wording against COPPA (USA) and the local children's privacy rules where the game launches.
Confirm that email plus a confirmation email is an acceptable way to get verifiable parental consent.
Confirm the data-retention and deletion promises.
